Name: Portable Community Center
Author: laceihaim
Description:
Portable Community Center lets you access and complete Community Center bundles from anywhere — just click the Junimo Note icon in your inventory!
[b]
📦 How to Install
[/b]
[b]Install SMAPI[/b]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have the latest version of SMAPI installed — it’s required for all Stardew Valley mods.
[/list][b]
Download PCC.[/b]
[list]
[*]Download Portable Community Center from this page.
[/list]
[b]Extract the Mod Folder[/b]
[list]
[*]Extract the downloaded .zip file. You should see a folder called PortableCommunityCenter.
[/list]
[b]Move to Mods Folder[/b]
[list]
[*]Place the entire PortableCommunityCenter folder inside your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
[/list]
[b]Launch the Game[/b]
[list]
[*]Run Stardew Valley through the SMAPI launcher. You’ll see a message confirming that Portable Community Center is loaded!
[/list]
[b]📦 How to Use[/b]

[list=1]
[*]First you have to unlock the community center.
[*]Open the mod menu normally from the inventory community center button.
[*]Add items manually from inventory or auto-complete ( cheating ) using Lewis's pants above the bundle image 
[*]In order to use the cheat button you must open "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\config.json" and change the boolean to true instead of false to see the auto-complete button.
[/list]
